descripcion: Care home and day centre, adapted housing, hoists, grab rails, ramps and lifts, plus tactile and audible wayfinding and the equipment used by blind and deaf people.

categorias.sala_estar: Care home lounge and dining room
categorias.habitacion: Care home bedroom and nurses' station
categorias.ciegos_sordos: Equipment for blind and deaf people, guide dog

sillon_geriatrico.descripcion: Firm, high-seated armchair with wooden arms to push up from and a back that reaches the head. Smooth wipe-clean upholstery.
sillon_geriatrico.imagen: Footprint of “High-back care home armchair”: a rectangle, 0.68 by 0.78 metres, marked with the letters “Sg”.

sillon_geriatrico_ruedas.descripcion: Transfer armchair on four castors, with a footrest and a tray in front. Reclined it is as long as a lounger; push it unbraked and it rolls.
sillon_geriatrico_ruedas.imagen: Footprint of “Reclining care chair on castors”: a rectangle, 0.72 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Sg”.

sillon_relax_reposapies.descripcion: Soft armchair with its footrest out: a narrower padded board sticks out in front of the seat at knee height. The cane meets it before the chair.
sillon_relax_reposapies.imagen: Footprint of “Recliner with footrest out”: a T shape, 0.85 by 1.55 metres, marked with the letters “Sr”.

hilera_sillones.descripcion: Several identical armchairs, arm to arm, lined up against the wall. Trail your hand from arm to arm; sitters' legs stick out into the way.
hilera_sillones.imagen: Footprint of “Row of lounge armchairs”: a rectangle, 2.60 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Hs”.

silla_comedor_brazos.descripcion: Heavy wooden chair with two arms to lean on when sitting down and getting up. Wider than an ordinary chair and hard to tip over.
silla_comedor_brazos.imagen: Footprint of “Dining chair with armrests”: a rectangle, 0.58 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

mesa_escotadura.descripcion: Dining table with a rounded bite out of each long side, so a wheelchair can pull in close. No apron: clear underneath to above the knee.
mesa_escotadura.imagen: Footprint of “Dining table with wheelchair cut-outs”: a rectangle with a rounded cut-out at the front and another at the back, 1.20 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

mesa_juegos_residencia.descripcion: Square table with blunted corners, a baize top and a raised lip so the tiles do not fall off. Four people usually sit around it.
mesa_juegos_residencia.imagen: Footprint of “Cards and dominoes table”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mj”.

televisor_sala_alto.descripcion: Large television hung on the wall above head height, with the volume up. The cane never touches it: you hear it across the lounge, a good landmark.
televisor_sala_alto.imagen: Footprint of “Lounge television mounted high”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ts”.

jaula_pajaros_sala.descripcion: Wire cage on a metal stand, at face height. The canaries sing now and then: you know where it is without touching it.
jaula_pajaros_sala.imagen: Footprint of “Birdcage on a stand”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Jp”.

panel_orientacion_fecha.descripcion: Board hung at face height with a large clock and the day, date and weather in raised letters. You hear it ticking as you come near.
panel_orientacion_fecha.imagen: Footprint of “Day and date orientation board”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Po”.

cama_geriatrica.nombre: Profiling care bed with side rails
cama_geriatrica.descripcion: Care home profiling bed with wooden head and foot boards and rails along the sides. It drops very low, almost to the floor, and rises on a motor. Walk round the foot.

variantes.ultrabaja: Ultra-low, a hand's width off the floor

cama_geriatrica.imagen: Footprint of “Profiling care bed with side rails”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 2.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

colchoneta_anticaidas.descripcion: Thin foam mat laid on the floor along the bed. You step on it: the floor suddenly turns soft and your steps go quiet.
colchoneta_anticaidas.imagen: Footprint of “Bedside fall mat”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

mesilla_bandeja_abatible.descripcion: Tall bedside cabinet on castors with a drawer. A tray lifts from one side and hangs out over the bed, at chest height for someone sitting up.
mesilla_bandeja_abatible.imagen: Footprint of “Bedside cabinet with fold-out tray”: a rectangle, 0.48 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

cabecero_luz_llamada.nombre: Bedhead unit with light and call button
cabecero_luz_llamada.descripcion: Long trunking screwed to the wall above the bedhead, over a sitter's head: it holds the light, the sockets and a pear push on a lead to call for help.
cabecero_luz_llamada.imagen: Footprint of “Bedhead unit with light and call button”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cl”.

incorporador_cama_colgante.nombre: Bed pole with hanging grab handle
incorporador_cama_colgante.descripcion: Tubular arm reaching over the headboard with a triangular handle dangling above the pillow. It hangs at face height when you lean over the bed.
incorporador_cama_colgante.imagen: Footprint of “Bed pole with hanging grab handle”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.30 by 0.70 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ic”.

alfombrilla_sensora_cama.descripcion: Very thin rubber mat at the bedside, with a lead. Step on it and the call sounds at the nurses' station: it tells staff someone has got up.
alfombrilla_sensora_cama.aviso: Sensor mat: stepping on it sounds the call at the nurses' station.
alfombrilla_sensora_cama.imagen: Footprint of “Bed-exit sensor floor mat”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

armario_barra_abatible.descripcion: Bedroom wardrobe with doors up to the ceiling. Inside, the hanging rail swings down to chest height when you pull a rod.
armario_barra_abatible.imagen: Footprint of “Wardrobe with pull-down hanging rail”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

silla_wc_noche.descripcion: Tubular chair with arms whose seat lifts: there is a pan underneath. It is left beside the bed at night.
silla_wc_noche.imagen: Footprint of “Bedside commode chair”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sw”.

mostrador_control_enfermeria.descripcion: L-shaped counter where the ward corridors meet. One run is high, to lean on standing, and the other low, to talk seated. The call panel sounds behind it.
mostrador_control_enfermeria.imagen: Footprint of “Nurses' station counter”: an L shape, 2.40 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

panel_llamadas_enfermeria.descripcion: Box on the station wall at face height, with a row of keys. It buzzes when someone calls from a bedroom.
panel_llamadas_enfermeria.imagen: Footprint of “Room call indicator panel”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.08 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pl”.

carro_lenceria_planta.descripcion: Tall wire trolley on castors, loaded with sheets, towels and pads, with a laundry bag hanging off it. In the mornings it stands in the corridor, in a different place each day.
carro_lenceria_planta.imagen: Footprint of “Ward linen trolley”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

mesa_terapia_herradura.descripcion: Curved half-moon table, height adjustable: the therapist sits in the hollow and the others round the outside of the curve. No corners at the front.
mesa_terapia_herradura.imagen: Footprint of “Horseshoe therapy table”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 1.80 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

panel_actividades_diarias.descripcion: Wooden board on the wall fitted with locks, bolts, switches, a tap and zips to practise on with your hands. It sticks out a hand's width at chest height.
panel_actividades_diarias.imagen: Footprint of “Daily living skills board”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

mesa_cultivo_adaptada.descripcion: Wooden box full of soil and plants, raised on four legs so you can garden seated. Knee room underneath; it smells of damp earth and herbs.
mesa_cultivo_adaptada.imagen: Footprint of “Raised wheelchair planter”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

pedalier_sentado.descripcion: Small device with two pedals placed on the floor in front of a chair. Low, at ankle height: you trip over it if you do not know it is there.
pedalier_sentado.imagen: Footprint of “Floor pedal exerciser”: a rectangle, 0.42 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

corro_sillas_gimnasia.nombre: Circle of chairs for seated exercise
corro_sillas_gimnasia.descripcion: Chairs set out in a circle facing inwards, with one gap to enter. Exercise is done seated; inside is an empty ring where the ball is passed round.
corro_sillas_gimnasia.imagen: Footprint of “Circle of chairs for seated exercise”: a ring with an opening at the front, 3.80 by 3.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

circuito_aros_picas.nombre: Floor circuit of hoops and poles
circuito_aros_picas.descripcion: Hoops, poles laid flat and low cones set out in a line to step over. A low, changing obstacle: it sounds like hollow plastic underfoot.
circuito_aros_picas.imagen: Footprint of “Floor circuit of hoops and poles”: an uneven strip of loose pieces, 3.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

cesto_psicomotricidad.nombre: Basket of soft balls and bands
cesto_psicomotricidad.descripcion: Round wicker basket, knee high, full of foam balls, stretch bands and small rings. Light: one knock tips it over.
cesto_psicomotricidad.imagen: Footprint of “Basket of soft balls and bands”: a circle, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

columna_burbujas.descripcion: Wide plastic tube full of water, from the floor to above head height, on a plinth. Switched on, bubbles gurgle upwards and the tube hums when you hug it.
columna_burbujas.imagen: Footprint of “Bubble tube”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

bombo_bingo_mesa.descripcion: Table with a round wire cage full of balls and a crank. Turn it and the balls rattle until one drops down the chute.
bombo_bingo_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Bingo cage on its table”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

inodoro_adaptado_barras.descripcion: Toilet higher than usual, set away from the walls so you can come alongside, with a rail on each side at hip height. You meet the rails before the bowl.
inodoro_adaptado_barras.imagen: Footprint of “Raised toilet with side rails”: the cistern at the back, the bowl in the middle and a thin rail on each side, 0.85 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Ia”.

lavabo_suspendido_regulable.descripcion: Basin hung on the wall, with no pedestal or cabinet: completely clear underneath for the knees. The cane passes under it and your hip finds it.
lavabo_suspendido_regulable.imagen: Footprint of “Height-adjustable wall basin”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.65 by 0.55 metres, hanging 0.68 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ls”.

alza_inodoro_marco.descripcion: Tubular frame wrapping round the sides and back of the toilet, with two armrests and a raised seat. Free-standing: it shifts a little when leant on.
alza_inodoro_marco.imagen: Footprint of “Toilet frame with raised seat”: a U open at the front, 0.60 by 0.52 metres, marked with the letters “Ai”.

barra_abatible_inodoro.descripcion: Double-tube rail sticking out from the wall like an arm at hip height, which swings up to stand vertical. Lowered, it reaches nearly a metre out: the cane passes under it.
barra_abatible_inodoro.imagen: Footprint of “Drop-down toilet rail”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 0.75 metres, hanging 0.55 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ba”.

barra_fija_pared.descripcion: Metal tube screwed to the wall at hip height, standing four fingers clear of it. Cold and firm: it takes your full body weight.
barra_fija_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Fixed wall grab rail”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.08 metres, hanging 0.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bf”.

barra_suelo_techo.descripcion: Upright tube wedged between floor and ceiling, beside the bath or the bed. As slim as a thick broom handle: the cane finds it, the hand takes longer.
barra_suelo_techo.imagen: Footprint of “Floor-to-ceiling support pole”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

plato_ducha_ras_suelo.descripcion: Shower area level with the rest of the floor, no kerb and no screen, with the drain in the middle. You walk or wheel straight in: the floor turns rough and wet.
plato_ducha_ras_suelo.aviso: Level-access shower: the floor is wet.
plato_ducha_ras_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Level-access shower floor”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Pd”.

asiento_ducha_abatible.descripcion: Slatted plastic seat hung on the shower wall, with no legs. Lowered, it juts out two hand-widths at knee height; folded, it lies flat against the wall.
asiento_ducha_abatible.imagen: Footprint of “Fold-down wall shower seat”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.42 metres, hanging 0.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ad”.

silla_ducha_ruedas.descripcion: Plastic and tubular chair on four small castors, with footrests and a seat open at the front. It gets wet all over; it rolls unless the brake is on.
silla_ducha_ruedas.imagen: Footprint of “Wheeled shower chair”: a rectangle, 0.56 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Sd”.

banqueta_ducha_regulable.descripcion: Round plastic stool on four aluminium legs with rubber feet. Light and backless: it slides when pushed.
banqueta_ducha_regulable.imagen: Footprint of “Adjustable shower stool”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bd”.

asiento_giratorio_banera.descripcion: Plastic seat with back and arms resting on both rims of the bath. It turns a quarter turn so you sit down from outside and then swing your legs in.
asiento_giratorio_banera.imagen: Footprint of “Swivel bath seat”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.72 by 0.55 metres, hanging 0.55 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ag”.

banera_con_puerta.descripcion: Short, very tall bath, waist high, with a small watertight door in its side and a seat inside. You step in through the door without lifting your leg over.
banera_con_puerta.imagen: Footprint of “Walk-in bath”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.40 by 0.72 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

mampara_baja_cuidador.descripcion: Plastic leaf only waist high that swings like a saloon door: you shower seated while your helper stays dry. Closed, it blocks the way into the shower.
mampara_baja_cuidador.imagen: Footprint of “Half-height carer shower screen”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.04 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

peldano_banera_asidero.descripcion: Loose step of rough plastic set on the floor beside the bath to make getting in easier. Low and easy to forget: you trip over it.
peldano_banera_asidero.imagen: Footprint of “Non-slip bath step”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.38 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

espejo_basculante_aseo.descripcion: Mirror tilted forwards above the basin, with a lever to move it. Its top edge stands a hand's width off the wall, at forehead height.
espejo_basculante_aseo.imagen: Footprint of “Tilting accessible mirror”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.15 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Eb”.

tirador_alarma_aseo.descripcion: Cord hanging from the ceiling beside the toilet almost to the floor, with two plastic rings. Pull it from floor level and the call for help sounds.
tirador_alarma_aseo.imagen: Footprint of “Emergency pull cord”: a circle, 0.08 by 0.08 metres, hanging 0.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ta”.

cambiador_adultos_abatible.descripcion: Plastic bench as long as a person hung on the wall, legless, at hip height. Lowered, it fills half the room and the cane passes underneath.
cambiador_adultos_abatible.imagen: Footprint of “Fold-down adult changing bench”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.75 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ca”.

encimera_regulable_hueco.descripcion: Run of worktop with no units underneath, held at its ends, which a motor raises and lowers. The cane goes underneath: your hip or hand finds it.
encimera_regulable_hueco.imagen: Footprint of “Height-adjustable worktop with knee space”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.62 metres, marked with the letters “Er”.

fregadero_adaptado_hueco.descripcion: Shallow steel sink with no cupboard below and the waste pushed back to the wall, leaving room for the knees. The tap has a long lever.
fregadero_adaptado_hueco.imagen: Footprint of “Shallow sink with knee space”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Fa”.

placa_coccion_adaptada.nombre: Hob with front controls and knee space
placa_coccion_adaptada.descripcion: Hob set into a worktop with no unit below, with the knobs on the front edge. Hot when on, and nothing underneath to warn the cane.
placa_coccion_adaptada.imagen: Footprint of “Hob with front controls and knee space”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

armarios_altos_descendentes.descripcion: Cupboards hung above the worktop whose insides come down on a motor until they rest on it. Up, they are at head height; down, they fill the worktop.
armarios_altos_descendentes.imagen: Footprint of “Pull-down wall cupboards”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.35 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Aa”.

horno_lateral_bandeja.descripcion: Unit with the oven at worktop height. The door opens sideways, like a cupboard, and a shelf slides out underneath to rest the hot dish on.
horno_lateral_bandeja.imagen: Footprint of “Side-opening oven with pull-out shelf”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.58 metres, marked with the letters “Hl”.

carro_camarera_apoyo.descripcion: Two-tray trolley on four castors with a tall handle: it carries the plates so you do not have to. It rolls when pushed and is never in the same place.
carro_camarera_apoyo.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen trolley walker”: a rectangle, 0.48 by 0.68 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

sillon_elevador.descripcion: Large soft armchair with a motor: it tips forwards to bring you almost to standing, or lies back with its footrest out. A handset hangs from it on a lead.
sillon_elevador.imagen: Footprint of “Riser recliner chair”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.82 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

asidero_cama_incorporarse.descripcion: Waist-high tubular hoop held under the mattress at one side of the bed. It stands up from the edge like a short rail to grip when getting up.
asidero_cama_incorporarse.imagen: Footprint of “Bed grab handle”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

grua_traslado_ruedas.descripcion: Tubular hoist on castors: at the bottom, two long legs spread in a U at floor level; at the top, a boom with a spreader bar at head height from which the sling hangs.
grua_traslado_ruedas.imagen: Footprint of “Mobile patient hoist”: a U open at the front, 0.68 by 1.25 metres, marked with the letters “Gt”.

grua_techo_rail.descripcion: Track screwed to the ceiling, from bed to bathroom, with a motor that runs along it. A metal spreader bar hangs from the motor and, when parked, sits at head height.
grua_techo_rail.imagen: Footprint of “Ceiling track hoist”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Gt”.

silla_salvaescaleras.descripcion: Folding seat mounted on a rail running up the stair wall. Parked at the bottom it narrows the first step; when moving it hums and beeps slowly.
silla_salvaescaleras.imagen: Footprint of “Stairlift on its rail”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Ss”.

plataforma_elevadora_vertical.descripcion: Sheet-metal platform with waist-high sides and a small gate, next to a few steps: it travels straight up and down like a short, slow lift.
plataforma_elevadora_vertical.imagen: Footprint of “Vertical platform lift”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

plataforma_salvaescaleras_plegable.descripcion: Platform that climbs an inclined rail on the stair wall. Folded, it is a flat upright box at the foot of the first step; open, it takes up the full width.
plataforma_salvaescaleras_plegable.imagen: Footprint of “Inclined platform stairlift”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

oruga_salvaescaleras.descripcion: Machine with two rubber tracks, like a small tank, and a tall handle, to which a wheelchair is clamped to climb the steps. It is kept at the foot of the stairs.
oruga_salvaescaleras.imagen: Footprint of “Portable stair climber”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Os”.

rampa_umbral_portatil.descripcion: Rubber or aluminium wedge pushed up against a small step or a door frame. You step on it: your foot feels a short slope and a change of material.
rampa_umbral_portatil.imagen: Footprint of “Portable threshold ramp”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.90 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ru”.

rampa_modular_barandilla.descripcion: Ramp of textured metal built in sections over some steps, with a tubular handrail on each side. It rings hollow underfoot and has a kerb along its edges.
rampa_modular_barandilla.aviso: Ramp with handrails: the slope starts here.
rampa_modular_barandilla.imagen: Footprint of “Modular ramp with handrails”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rm”.

pasamanos_doble_altura.descripcion: Two round wooden rails, one above the other, along the corridor wall: the upper at hip height and the lower at thigh height. Trail your hand along it to the door.
pasamanos_doble_altura.imagen: Footprint of “Double-height handrail”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.08 metres, hanging 0.65 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pd”.

scooter_movilidad_cargando.descripcion: Four-wheeled electric vehicle with a swivel seat, a front basket and handlebars, parked by a socket. The charger hums and the lead runs across to the wall.
scooter_movilidad_cargando.imagen: Footprint of “Mobility scooter parked on charge”: a wide seat at the back, a narrow footboard and the handlebars across it near the front, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Sm”.

silla_evacuacion_colgada.descripcion: Folded chair in a cover, hung on the landing wall at hip height. It sticks out a good hand's width and the cane passes under it.
silla_evacuacion_colgada.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-hung evacuation chair”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.25 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Se”.

disco_transferencia.descripcion: Flat plastic disc, the size of a tray, that spins on itself. It is left on the floor by the bed so you can turn standing without moving your feet: step on it and it moves.
disco_transferencia.aviso: Turning disc on the floor: it spins under your feet.
disco_transferencia.imagen: Footprint of “Transfer turning disc”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Dt”.

plano_tactil_atril.nombre: Tactile floor plan on a lectern
plano_tactil_atril.descripcion: Raised-line and braille plan on a sloping board at hand height, on a narrow pedestal. The board overhangs the pedestal: your hand reaches it before the cane does.
plano_tactil_atril.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile floor plan on a lectern”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.80 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

plano_tactil_pared.descripcion: Raised-line and braille plate screwed to the wall by the entrance to the floor, at chest height. It sticks out three fingers; read it standing, with both hands.
plano_tactil_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted tactile plan”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pt”.

maqueta_tactil_edificio.descripcion: Wooden model of the building on a table, made to be touched: walls, doors, stairs and courtyards in the round, with braille labels along the edge.
maqueta_tactil_edificio.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile model of the building”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.20 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

franja_guia_interior.descripcion: Narrow rubber strip with lengthwise ribs, stuck onto the smooth lobby floor. Follow it with your cane or foot from the door to the counter.
franja_guia_interior.imagen: Footprint of “Indoor stick-on guidance strip”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Fg”.

loseta_cruce_guia.descripcion: Square of studs where two guidance strips cross or fork. When you feel it underfoot, stop and decide which way to go on.
loseta_cruce_guia.aviso: Guidance strips cross: the path divides here.
loseta_cruce_guia.imagen: Footprint of “Guidance path junction tile”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Lc”.

franja_botones_escalera.nombre: Stud warning strip at indoor stairs
franja_botones_escalera.descripcion: Strip of studs stuck across the floor in front of the first step of a staircase. It warns you: the drop begins one pace further on.
franja_botones_escalera.aviso: Warning studs: stairs start just ahead.
franja_botones_escalera.imagen: Footprint of “Stud warning strip at indoor stairs”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Fb”.

bandas_contraste_peldanos.descripcion: Rough strip, like sandpaper, stuck along the edge of a step from side to side. Foot and cane feel it gritty: it marks where the step ends.
bandas_contraste_peldanos.aviso: Rough strip: the edge of a step.
bandas_contraste_peldanos.imagen: Footprint of “Non-slip stair nosing strips”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

felpudo_encastrado_vestibulo.descripcion: Matting of aluminium bars and stiff bristle strips set in a well, flush with the floor, just inside the door. It rattles and scrapes underfoot: you are coming in.
felpudo_encastrado_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Recessed entrance matting”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Fe”.

placa_braille_puerta.descripcion: Small plate with raised letters and braille, to the right of the door frame at elbow height. Find it by sliding your hand along the wall from the frame.
placa_braille_puerta.imagen: Footprint of “Braille door sign”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.03 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pb”.

directorio_braille_voz.descripcion: Free-standing panel in the lobby listing floors and services in raised print and braille, with a large button at bottom right that reads it aloud.
directorio_braille_voz.imagen: Footprint of “Braille and speech directory”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Db”.

pasamanos_braille.descripcion: Tubular stair handrail with a small braille tag at the start and end of each flight, on its inner face: it tells you which floor you are on.
pasamanos_braille.imagen: Footprint of “Handrail with braille floor marker”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.07 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pb”.

rotulo_banderola_bajo.descripcion: Sign sticking out at right angles from the wall, like a stiff flag, at forehead height. It is thin and the cane gives no warning: you walk into it face first.
rotulo_banderola_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low projecting sign”: a rectangle, 0.04 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rb”.

baliza_orientacion_interior.descripcion: Small speaker box above the door or the counter, over head height. It repeats a sharp, dry “tock, tock”: walk towards the sound to reach the spot.
baliza_orientacion_interior.imagen: Footprint of “Indoor audible wayfinding beacon”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.10 metres, hanging 2.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bo”.

pulsador_asistencia_pared.descripcion: Large round button in a small wall box at hip height, with braille beside it. Press it and it buzzes, and a member of staff comes.
pulsador_asistencia_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Assistance call button”: a rectangle, 0.10 by 0.05 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

intercomunicador_accesible.descripcion: Metal plate on the wall by the door, lower than an ordinary entry phone, with one large raised button and a grille. A voice answers when you call.
intercomunicador_accesible.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible entrance intercom”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.08 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ia”.

mostrador_accesible_bucle.descripcion: Two-height counter: a high run for standing and a low one with knee space. The low run has a hearing loop: with a hearing aid on T you hear the clerk without the room noise.
mostrador_accesible_bucle.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible counter with hearing loop”: a rectangle with a knee recess at the front left, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

puerta_automatica_detector.nombre: Automatic door with sensor and chime
puerta_automatica_detector.descripcion: Sliding glass door that opens by itself as you approach, with a beep and the hiss of the leaves. Closed it is a full pane of glass; wait a moment in front of it.
puerta_automatica_detector.imagen: Footprint of “Automatic door with sensor and chime”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

poste_pulsador_puerta.descripcion: Square waist-high post a couple of paces before the door, with a large pad you press with hand, elbow or cane to make the door open.
poste_pulsador_puerta.imagen: Footprint of “Door-opener push pad post”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

lupa_television_mesa.descripcion: Desk with a tall device: a large screen and, beneath it, a sliding tray where the page goes to be seen hugely enlarged. The tray moves when touched.
lupa_television_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Video magnifier on its desk”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Lt”.

puesto_linea_braille.descripcion: Desk with a talking computer and, in front of the keyboard, a strip of pins that rise and fall under your fingers. You hear the synthetic voice and the typing.
puesto_linea_braille.imagen: Footprint of “Computer desk with braille display”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

maquina_perkins_mesa.descripcion: Table with a heavy cast-iron braille writer with six keys and a lever. Each letter is a sharp thump; a bell rings at the end of the line.
maquina_perkins_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Perkins brailler on its table”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

impresora_braille_mueble.descripcion: Closed cabinet with a lid, hip high, housing the braille embosser. Even shut, when it prints it hammers loudly enough to hear from the corridor.
impresora_braille_mueble.imagen: Footprint of “Braille embosser in its cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Ib”.

horno_relieves.descripcion: Sheet-metal machine on a table, with a lid that lowers onto a plastic sheet to copy a drawing in relief. It blows hot air: do not rest your hand on it.
horno_relieves.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile graphics fuser”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Hr”.

estanteria_libros_braille.descripcion: Deep, sturdy shelving: braille books are wide, tall volumes and a single novel fills a whole shelf. The spines carry braille labels.
estanteria_libros_braille.imagen: Footprint of “Braille book shelving”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.42 metres, marked with the letters “El”.

mesa_ajedrez_adaptado.descripcion: Small table with a chessboard whose dark squares are raised and where each piece pegs into a hole. The white pieces have a dot on top.
mesa_ajedrez_adaptado.imagen: Footprint of “Adapted chess table”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

telefono_teclas_grandes_mesita.descripcion: Narrow hall stand with a landline telephone with huge keys and a loud ringer that also flashes when it rings. The lead runs down to the skirting.
telefono_teclas_grandes_mesita.imagen: Footprint of “Big-button telephone on its stand”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.38 metres, marked with the letters “Tt”.

timbre_luminoso.descripcion: Small box high on the wall that, when someone rings the door, sounds loudly and flashes for anyone who cannot hear. It is above head height.
timbre_luminoso.imagen: Footprint of “Flashing doorbell”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 0.06 metres, hanging 1.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tl”.

reloj_parlante_repisa.descripcion: Short shelf at chest height holding a clock with one large button: press it and a voice tells the time. In between it ticks quietly.
reloj_parlante_repisa.imagen: Footprint of “Talking clock on its shelf”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.18 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rp”.

punto_videointerpretacion.descripcion: Free-standing lectern by the counter with a screen at chest height: it connects by video to a sign language interpreter. A tone sounds when calling.
punto_videointerpretacion.imagen: Footprint of “Sign language video relay point”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

panel_pictogramas.descripcion: Large board on the wall with simple pictures in raised squares, for asking for things by pointing. It sticks out only slightly, from waist to head.
panel_pictogramas.imagen: Footprint of “Pictogram communication board”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.04 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pp”.

bastonero_bastones_blancos.descripcion: Low metal holder against the wall by the entrance, with slots where canes are stood upright. Touch it and the canes clink.
bastonero_bastones_blancos.imagen: Footprint of “White cane rack”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.40 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

bebedero_comedero_perro_guia.nombre: Guide dog water and food bowls
bebedero_comedero_perro_guia.descripcion: Two steel bowls side by side on a rubber tray, on the floor against the wall. Low and full of water: kick them and they splash and clang.
bebedero_comedero_perro_guia.imagen: Footprint of “Guide dog water and food bowls”: an elongated oval with straight sides and round ends, 0.60 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

cama_perro_guia.descripcion: Oval cushion with a soft raised rim, on the floor beside the desk or in a corner. Low and squashy; the dog is often lying on it.
cama_perro_guia.imagen: Footprint of “Guide dog bed”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.90 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.
